segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Provides private banking, lending activities, deposit generation and treasury management services to businesses, non-profits and consumers through the Bank.
segments.evidence: The Banking segment includes: commercial (includes C&I and equipment financing), commercial real estate, multifamily, residential and consumer lending activities; treasury management services; C&I advisory services; escrow management; deposit generation; operation of ATMs; telephone and internet banking services; merchant credit card services and customer support sales.

segments.name: Wealth Management
products: investment management services for individuals and institutions
services as executor, trustee, administrator, custodian
other financial planning and advisory services
segments.description: Delivers investment management, personal trust and financial planning services to individuals, families, foundations and institutions through the wealth management division.
segments.evidence: The Wealth Management Division includes: investment management services for individuals and institutions; personal trust services, including services as executor, trustee, administrator, custodian; and other financial planning and advisory services.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay interest and fees on loans and deposits, while wealth management clients pay fees based on asset values and services rendered.
revenueModel.evidence: Loans and investments primarily provide the revenues in the banking operation and wealth management fee income provides the revenues for the Wealth Management Division.
